hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'git commit'; then make -C "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" before-commit; fi

if [ -z "$STOP_HOOK_ACTIVE" ]; then export STOP_HOOK_ACTIVE=1; CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx)$' | head -1); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then echo 'Code was edited but no dev server is running. If the change is observable in a browser preview (per <when_to_verify>), call preview_start and follow <verification_workflow>. If not, end your turn without mentioning this check — do not announce that you are skipping.'; fi; fi
